name: Papercut
summary: Vox-style collage explainer: warm grained paper, photos as paper cut-outs, news and research clippings with a highlighter sweep and a marker circle, torn-paper scraps for the headline and beat text, masking-tape labels, drawn scenes sliding in as paper sheets in stop-motion steps.
lexicon: dip to black, punch-in, push, zoom transition (per beat)
best_for: stories about real people and events, history, business case studies: anything with names, dates, documents and quotes
footage: full-bleed, any; photos of people as transparent PNG cut-outs; screenshots of articles or papers as clippings (assets/cutouts/, assets/clippings/)
music: plucky or light percussive bed, 95-120 BPM; paper rustles and a stamp thud as sfx
sfx: paper slide on each sheet push, marker squeak on a circle, one stamp thud
